title: Google designates "back button hijacking" as malicious, saying sites interfering with a browser's back button function may be demoted in Search starting in June (Abner Li/9to5Google)
summary: Abner Li / 9to5Google: Google designates “back button hijacking” as malicious, saying sites interfering with a browser's back button function may be demoted in Search starting in June — Websites that engage in “back button hijacking” might soon appear less prominently in Google Search results as part of a new spam policy.
contentText:
Abner Li / 9to5Google :

Google designates “back button hijacking” as malicious, saying sites interfering with a browser's back button function may be demoted in Search starting in June   —  Websites that engage in “back button hijacking” might soon appear less prominently in Google Search results as part of a new spam policy.
